subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Deliciously Addictive Books, New Workout Tools, A Small Article with Big Payoffs, and More

bullets.title: Zitarrosa
bullets.creator: Bajofondo
bullets.note: ([YouTube](https://youtu.be/goQGBkkuVpE?si=hKmPBNWHF_erd9_m), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/3LsIKnWBQhqjQ5TWNxJenK), [Amazon Music](https://www.amazon.com/Zitarrosa-Album-Version/dp/B001C3G8OQ)) by [Bajofondo](https://linktr.ee/Bajofondo). Ideal for a summer weekend, this track is great for cooking, writing, dancing, or simply calming yourself. It does it all. I first found Bajofondo when I [lived in Buenos Aires and traveled through Uruguay many lifetimes ago](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5pWmhBm-CiI). From Wikipedia: “Bajofondo is a Río de la Plata-based music band consisting of eight musicians from Argentina and Uruguay, which aims to create a more contemporary version of tango and other musical styles of the Río de la Plata region.”

bullets.section: Book I devoured in one sitting
bullets.title: Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow
bullets.creator: Gabrielle Zevin
bullets.note:
. I could not stop reading this book. It’s a page-turner in the most addictive sense and was not only a _New York Times_ bestseller, but it also placed #76 on the NYT’s list of The 100 Best Books of the 21st Century.  
​  
The less you know about this book before you read it, the better, in my opinion, but if you must get a tease, here’s a snippet of the description: “Sam and Sadie—two college friends, often in love, but never lovers—become creative partners in a dazzling and intricately imagined world of video game design, where success brings them fame, joy, tragedy, duplicity, and, ultimately, a kind of immortality. It is a love story, but not one you have read before.”

bullets.section: Newest workout staple that I’m loving
bullets.title: TANK M3 Push Sled
bullets.note: This is, bar none, the best sled I have ever used for pushing or pulling. 10–15-minute workouts in the morning sun have become my favorite way to set the stage for a great, mood-elevated day. The ease of rotation and traction makes it perfect for even a gravel driveway like mine. From the description: “Designed with patented Mag-Force™ Resistance Technology, the TANK M3 delivers scalable intensity, accommodating many fitness levels while minimizing the need for weight plates and clunky user swaps. The TANK M3’s three-wheeled design glides effortlessly across turf, rubber, or concrete, ensuring smooth operation on any surface. Ergonomic multi-position handles allow users to switch grips seamlessly, enhancing comfort and workout variety. Real-time performance monitoring helps users track progress and training metrics with an oversized digital screen to empower better workouts.”
